jobs.description_text: The Media Experience team exists to empower users to discover, consume, and engage with the best media content on Reddit. Our north star is growing video views and video users . These are users who consistently return to Reddit for the unique, authentic content that fuels our communities. Achieving this level of consistent engagement requires a product flywheel that surfaces the right video features, UI optimizations, and playback improvements at the right moment to accelerate organic engagement. jobs.description_text: Position Summary: Join Redwood Materials to validate the high-voltage power electronics behind the world’s energy storage systems. You’ll design and run validation tests on components and assemblies operating at 400–2000VDC and 480–800VAC. You’ll work directly from schematics, Altium layouts, and datasheets to understand switching topologies, gate drive, isolation, protection, and thermal behavior, then use that understanding to build sharper tests. When something fails, you’ll probe the circuit, isolate the fault, and drive root cause to the component level. You’ll design and source custom PCBAs for characterization, build electrical-focused test infrastructure with mechanical and software elements, and write Python tools to automate testing and analyze data. Working alongside design, reliability, and abuse engineers on FMEAs and test plans, you’ll turn complex data into design and process improvements that ship. If you thrive at the bench, love finding the real cause of a failure, and want your work to matter from day one, this is your role. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Design, set up, and execute validation tests on high-voltage power electronics components and assemblies Read and work directly from schematics, Altium layouts, and datasheets to understand circuit behavior and inform test design Debug and diagnose hardware hands-on — probe circuits, isolate faults, and drive root cause investigations to the component level Design, fabricate, and source custom PCBAs
